sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员服务和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森百货的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《内在工作》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的收听。

sentences.en: This week's main episode was all about Tourette's, and we were talking with Jason about that.
sentences.zh: 本周的主题是关于妥瑞氏症，我们和杰森聊了聊这个话题。

sentences.en: And as I've been kind of thinking, what should I talk to you guys about?
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考，我该和大家聊些什么呢？

sentences.en: I was thinking the idea of self-acceptance versus what we can change, what we can't change,
sentences.zh: 我在想“自我接纳”与“我们能改变什么、不能改变什么”之间的关系，

sentences.en: and kind of what we just need to put up with.
sentences.zh: 以及我们不得不忍受些什么。

sentences.en: And I was reminded of the very noisy debate on social media about Stephen Bartlett saying on his podcast that having a few glasses of wine had ruined his next few days.
sentences.zh: 我回想起社交媒体上关于斯蒂芬·巴特利特的一场激烈辩论，他在播客中说，喝了几杯红酒毁了他接下来的几天。

sentences.en: People have not all been super supportive of that.
sentences.zh: 人们对此并不完全支持。

sentences.en: What I will say is as someone who doesn't drink anymore, I've never drunk problematically, I wouldn't say.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，作为一个不再喝酒的人，我以前从没觉得喝酒是个问题，我不会这么说。

sentences.en: But I just realised that I didn't need that in my life anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我只是意识到，我的生活中不再需要它了。

sentences.en: I don't know if Stephen Bartlett has reached that same stage of kind of realisation.
sentences.zh: 我不知道斯蒂芬·巴特利特是否也达到了同样的认知阶段。

sentences.en: Maybe he will after this.
sentences.zh: 也许经历这件事后他会达到。

sentences.en: Maybe he'll be like, well, I'll show you.
sentences.zh: 也许他会想，好吧，我证明给你们看。

sentences.en: I'm not going to have that ruin my life anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不会再让这种事毁了我的生活。

sentences.en: I'd love to know what your thoughts are.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你们的想法。

sentences.en: What are your relationships or stages of change with alcohol or substances?
sentences.zh: 你与酒精或物质的关系如何？或者你处于改变的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: Have you decided to put them down?
sentences.zh: 你决定戒掉它们了吗？

sentences.en: But it's that idea of what we can optimise and what we can't optimise.
sentences.zh: 但这涉及到一个概念：我们能优化什么，不能优化什么。

sentences.en: And this might be timely as well, because I'm recording this at a point where I've broken my hand.
sentences.zh: 这可能也很及时，因为我录制这段内容时，我的手骨折了。

sentences.en: I broke my hand whilst trying to optimise myself, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，我是在试图优化自己的过程中弄断了手。

sentences.en: So I've broken my fourth metacarpal bone, which if you are not watching this on YouTube, you might be like, I don't know where that is.
sentences.zh: 我折断了第四掌骨，如果你不是在YouTube上观看，你可能不知道那在哪里。

sentences.en: If you look at the back of your own hand, look at your ring finger, that bone that runs down your hand is basically where your metacarpal will be.
sentences.zh: 如果你看自己的手背，看无名指，那根延伸到手掌的骨头基本上就是你的掌骨位置。

sentences.en: I've been into the hand clinic today, which is over a week after I broke it, over a week after I had it x-rayed.
sentences.zh: 我今天去了手部诊所，那是在我骨折一周多之后，也是拍完X光一周多之后。

sentences.en: And the medic maybe, I don't know, saw a little bit of perfectionism in me and said, oh, of all the bones that you could have broken,
sentences.zh: 医生可能，我不知道，看出了我身上的一点完美主义倾向，他说，哦，在所有你能折断的骨头中，

sentences.en: the fourth metacarpal is the best one to have broken because it heals really nicely.
sentences.zh: 第四掌骨是最好的，因为它愈合得非常好。

sentences.en: So well, well done for choosing that one to break.
sentences.zh: 所以，干得好，选了这根骨头来折断。

sentences.en: And I was like, it wasn't really a choice, but thank you.
sentences.zh: 我说，这其实不是我的选择，但谢谢你。

sentences.en: And I hope it does heal nicely.
sentences.zh: 我希望它能愈合得好。

sentences.en: So mine is my right hand.
sentences.zh: 我折断的是右手。

sentences.en: So that is not ideal.
sentences.zh: 这可不太理想。

sentences.en: But I was in there trying to just really work on my wellness.
sentences.zh: 但我当时确实是在努力改善自己的健康状况。

sentences.en: I was in the gym.
sentences.zh: 我在健身房。

sentences.en: This is where the optimisation came in.
sentences.zh: 这就是“优化”发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: I was in the gym.
sentences.zh: 我在健身房。

sentences.en: And of course, I didn't know that I'd end up having an accident and breaking my hand.
sentences.zh: 当然，我没想到最后会发生意外，把手弄骨折了。

sentences.en: That is what has happened in reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实中发生的事情。

sentences.en: And now it's kind of set back my goals.
sentences.zh: 现在这有点阻碍了我的目标。

sentences.en: So I didn't know that I would end up hurting myself and then not being able to exercise.
sentences.zh: 所以我没想到最后会伤到自己，然后无法锻炼。

sentences.en: I'm able to do sit-ups.
sentences.zh: 我还能做仰卧起坐。

sentences.en: Sit-ups are pretty much all I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 仰卧起坐几乎是我现在唯一能做的运动。

sentences.en: I did think earlier now that I'm a little bit less hand anxious.
sentences.zh: 我早些时候想，既然我现在对手的焦虑少了一些，

sentences.en: I could probably do some squats, but I can't run really.
sentences.zh: 我可能可以做些深蹲，但我真的不能跑步。

sentences.en: It's probably not safe to be running with my hand in a splint when I might fall over and injure myself again.
sentences.zh: 戴着夹板跑步可能不安全，因为我可能会摔倒，再次受伤。

sentences.en: I can't drive for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 我有六周不能开车。

sentences.en: So it's encouraging me to just, I guess, accept where I am and not optimise.
sentences.zh: 所以这在鼓励我，我想，去接受我现在的处境，而不是去优化它。

sentences.en: And I appreciate someone with a Tourette's diagnosis may not necessarily have that level
sentences.zh: 我很理解，患有妥瑞氏症的人可能不一定有那种程度的

sentences.en: of kind of optimisation, sub-optimisation, on days, off days, because it might not be something that they can control in the same way that you can do that.
sentences.zh: 优化、次优化、状态好坏之分，因为这可能不是他们能像你那样控制的事情。

sentences.en: But I guess I would be interested in whether kind of mindfulness is an approach which might help someone with Tourette's.
sentences.zh: 但我确实很好奇，正念是否是一种能帮助妥瑞氏症患者的方法。

sentences.en: That is something I meant to ask Jason.
sentences.zh: 这是我本想问杰森的问题。

sentences.en: Perhaps I'll ask.
sentences.zh: 也许我会问问。

sentences.en: And we can cover that in future.
sentences.zh: 我们以后可以讨论一下。

sentences.en: But yeah, what relationship have you got?
sentences.zh: 但是，你和它是什么关系呢？

sentences.en: I was speaking to someone today about, I guess, that gestalt idea of when you feel like
sentences.zh: 我今天和某人谈论了格式塔心理学中关于当你觉得

sentences.en: you've got to do things and then just tweaking it a little bit and thinking, well, am I getting to do that?
sentences.zh: 你必须做某事，然后稍微调整一下，思考：我真的需要做这个吗？

sentences.en: Because am I, in fact, choosing to do that?
sentences.zh: 因为，我实际上是在选择做这件事吗？

sentences.en: So I guess even with the Stephen Bartlett example, if I'm choosing to drink alcohol, I guess more than a glass or two, then am I choosing to have disrupted sleep?
sentences.zh: 所以我想，即使以斯蒂芬·巴特利特的例子来说，如果我选择喝酒，我想超过一两杯，那么我是在选择睡眠质量下降吗？

sentences.en: Am I choosing to then be a bit cranky with my kids the next day because I'm, you know, coming out the after effects of drinking alcohol?
sentences.zh: 我是在选择第二天因为酒精的后遗症而对孩子们发脾气吗？

sentences.en: For me, I didn't choose to do that.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我没有选择这样做。

sentences.en: I didn't want to.
sentences.zh: 我不想那样。

sentences.en: My kids didn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们以前睡不好。

sentences.en: So when they were very young, I thought, I'm not adding alcohol into the mix because any time my head hits the pillow, I want to actually be getting that benefit of the sleep.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们很小的时候，我想，我不会在生活中加入酒精，因为每当我的头碰到枕头，我想要真正获得睡眠带来的益处。

sentences.en: So for me, alcohol just didn't make sense in my life.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，酒精在我的生活中根本没有意义。

sentences.en: And for me, it helped me just be firmer in my choices, I think.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，它帮助我在选择上更加坚定。

sentences.en: I just don't drink.
sentences.zh: 我只是不喝酒。

sentences.en: It means I can drive when I can drive when I haven't got a broken hand.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当我的手没骨折时，我可以开车。

sentences.en: I can drive whenever I want to.
sentences.zh: 我想什么时候开车就什么时候开车。

sentences.en: How will we get there?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么过去？

sentences.en: How will we get home?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么回家？

sentences.en: Well, I'll drive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我来开车。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It just makes things simpler.
sentences.zh: 这让事情变得简单多了。

sentences.en: And, you know, days gone by, I think it would have made things cheaper.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，过去我认为这会让事情更便宜。

sentences.en: I don't think that's the case anymore because you can easily pay as much for a mocktail or even a non-alcoholic drink sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我不认为现在还是这样，因为有时候你买一杯无酒精鸡尾酒甚至非酒精饮料的价格和含酒精饮料一样贵。

sentences.en: I think a pint of Coke in London is about £5.50, £6, depending on where you buy it from.
sentences.zh: 我想在伦敦，一杯可乐大约要5.5英镑到6英镑，取决于你在哪里买。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's a higher end place.
sentences.zh: 当然，那是高档场所。

sentences.en: But I mean, that's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，那是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: That isn't, you know, well, maybe let's think about how much the alcohol would be there as
sentences.zh: 那不是，你知道，好吧，也许让我们想想那里的酒精饮料要多少钱，

sentences.en: well, but I would love to learn more about what your relationship is like with acceptance and
sentences.zh: 但我很想了解你与接纳和优化之间的关系，并思考它是如何在你身上体现的，无论你是否有任何身体健康或心理健康方面的诊断或症状。

sentences.en: optimisation and to think about how that shows up for you, whether you've got any physical health or mental health diagnoses or symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 我很想多了解一下这一点。

sentences.en: And I would just love to learn more about that.
sentences.zh: 我很想多了解一下这一点。

sentences.en: Thank you for watching or listening to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 感谢你观看或收听《内在工作》节目。

sentences.en: The next episode will be available on Wednesday evening.
sentences.zh: 下一集将于周三晚上发布。

sentences.en: Now, at the moment, I'm just trying to get myself into a predictable pattern.
sentences.zh: 目前，我只是在努力让自己进入一个可预测的模式。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be around 7.30pm on a Wednesday evening.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是周三晚上7点半左右。

sentences.en: And I think that will happen both on YouTube and wherever you get your podcasts at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我想届时YouTube和你们收听播客的平台会同时更新。

sentences.en: I think that's the plan.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是计划。

sentences.en: But again, I'd love your feedback on this.
sentences.zh: 但同样，我很期待你们的反馈。

sentences.en: You know, I don't get everything right all of the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不可能一直都做对所有事情。

sentences.en: So originally, I launched Inner Work as a members-only service where you guys paid to get these episodes.
sentences.zh: 最初，我将《内在工作》作为会员专享服务推出，你们需要付费才能收听这些剧集。

sentences.en: But I just thought, you know what, I would sooner, if I'm creating the content, I'd sooner it get listened to, get watched, you know.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想，你知道吗，如果我在创作内容，我更希望它能被听到、被看到。

sentences.en: So every day is a school day.
sentences.zh: 所以每天都是学习的一天。

sentences.en: And I guess maybe this is part of my optimisation journey as well.
sentences.zh: 我想这也许也是我优化之旅的一部分。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的陪伴。

sentences.en: Thank you for choosing to be a listener or a viewer on Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 感谢你选择成为《内在工作》的听众或观众。

sentences.en: And I'll look forward to bringing you the next episode next week.
sentences.zh: 我很期待下周为你带来下一集。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员服务和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森百货的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。
